data.content_ref: inline:Replace grounded extension with ideal semantics as the skeptical operator: the ideal extension is the maximal admissible set contained in every preferred extension — unique, skeptical, and strictly more decisive than grounded — and is computable in polynomial time via iterated grounded-extension calls on the reduced framework. Determinism is preserved; the cost is the re-derivation of reinstatement and committed-root validity as theorems of the new semantics, and the loss of the simple two-label fixpoint story.
